e.title: Prudential plc 的第三方 API 面画像（API Evangelist）：把「我是什么、我不是什么」写成声明式纪律
e.title_en: API Evangelist’s third-party profile of Prudential plc’s API surface: turning "what this is and is not" into declarative discipline
e.title_hk: Prudential plc 的第三方 API 面畫像（API Evangelist）：把「我是什麼、我不是什麼」寫成聲明式紀律
e.summary: API Evangelist 对 Prudential plc 公开 API 面的独立第三方画像：仅采集任何公众用浏览器、无需凭证即可取得的材料，并在开篇逐项声明「这不是我们的 API」「评分只评已发布产物，不评软件的安全与质量」；含无理由下架权与公布的服务时限
e.summary_en: API Evangelist’s independent third-party profile of Prudential plc’s public API surface: it uses only material any member of the public can reach with a browser and no credentials, and opens by declaring item by item that "this is not our API" and that the rating scores published artifacts rather than software safety or quality; it also grants removal on request without justification and publishes service-level response times
e.summary_hk: API Evangelist 對 Prudential plc 公開 API 面的獨立第三方畫像：僅採集任何公眾用瀏覽器、無需憑證即可取得的材料，並在開篇逐項聲明「這不是我們的 API」「評分只評已發布產物，不評軟件的安全與質量」；含無理由下架權與公布的服務時限
e.body:
**prudential-plc-api-profile** 是 **API Evangelist 对 Prudential plc 公开 API 面的独立第三方画像**（仓库 `api-evangelist/prudential-plc`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言未标注、仓库体量 121 KB、创建于 2026-07-25、最后推送 2026-09-04**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**；**⚠️ 其 `pushed` 为 2026-09-04，严格落在本轮解冻窗口（`>2026-09-05`）之外——本条目如实标注，并非窗口内发现**。**其 topics 逐字实测达 20 项，且直接覆盖本词条所在站点关注的区域与险种**：**hong-kong、bancassurance、takaful、life-insurance、health-insurance、pensions、asset-management、responsible-ai、africa、asia、united-kingdom、vietnam、indonesia、malaysia、philippines、singapore、carrier、apis-json、eastspring、asset-management**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，10,033 字节**）：**仓库自述定位逐字**：**「Prudential plc — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist.」**；**并逐字说明 Prudential plc 为在英格兰与威尔士注册的人寿与健康保险及资产管理集团，在伦敦、香港、新加坡与纽约交易所上市，**主要营运办公室在香港****。⭐⭐⭐ **本条目最有价值的不是这份画像的内容，而是它在开篇写下的「Provenance（来源与声明）」区块——它逐项交代了自己是什么、不是什么**，**共六条，逐字实测如下**：
**① 「This is not our API.」**——**「该仓库是某公司**公开可用** API 面的独立第三方画像，由 API Evangelist 维护；API Evangelist 不运营、不托管、不转售、不支持该公司的 API，且除画像中另有说明外与该公司的关联或背书。**」
**② 来源纪律**——**「此处一切信息均由**任何公众成员用浏览器、无需任何凭证**即可取得的材料汇编而成——公司自身网站、开发者门户与文档、其公开发布的规范（OpenAPI、AsyncAPI、JSON Schema、`apis.json`、`llms.txt` 等）、其公开仓库、以及其公开的状态/定价/变更日志页面」**；⭐ **并以一句极强的否定句收尾：「Nothing here is obtained by breaching a system, defeating an access control, or using credentials of any kind.」——此处没有任何内容是通过入侵系统、绕过访问控制或使用任何形式的凭证取得的**。
**③ 评分范围声明**——**「该评分是独立评估」**：**Kin Score 与 Agent Readiness 是对一家公司**公开** API 产物、依已公布评分标准独立计算的分数**；⭐ **逐字强调「They are not certifications, endorsements, security assessments, or audits, and they score published artifacts — not the quality, safety, or security of the software.」——它们不是认证、背书、安全评估或审计，它们评的是**已发布的产物**，而**不是该软件的质量、安全性或安全防护****。
**④ 更正、重评与下架免费**——**「无需任何合作、合同或购买，且你不需要为请求给出理由。」**
**⑤ 下架承诺逐字**——**「Want the listing taken down? Say so and we will honor it.」**；**下架后画像缩减为公司名、事实性描述与其自身网站链接，且该公司记为 **unrated（未评级）****；⭐ **并逐字承诺「never scored zero for having asked」——绝不会因为提出请求而被评为零分**。
**⑥ 公布的服务时限**——**「确认在一个工作日内；下架或限制在两个工作日内；更正与重评在五个工作日内。」**

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「第三方画像的自律范本」是本轮最有价值的发现，且它与本词条所在站点的做法同源**——**本站同样是对机构做第三方、无凭证、逐条标注来源的画像；而 API Evangelist 把这件事的**边界**写成了声明式条款**：**不是我们的 API／不用凭证／评分不等于安全审计／可无理由下架／不因请求而给零分／承诺响应时限**。**六条里有四条是在**主动限制自己结论的射程****；**对做研究报告、行业分析或机构画像的学生，这是一份可直接借用的「我这样写，但请这样读」模板**（**可与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、同轮思路的第 319 轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「what it does not prove」、[[insurance-review]] 的「待核实事项」并读——**四条都在处理同一件事：让别人无法把你的结论读得比它实际更强****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「不用任何凭证」这一来源纪律值得单独记一笔**——**它与本会话第 317 轮实测到的 `register.eiopa.europa.eu` 403、第 316 轮 `HCAA` 403 等阻断形成对照**：**当权威来源有访问门槛时，第三方画像要么放弃、要么改用公开可得材料并**明说材料边界****；**API Evangelist 选了后者并把这条写进首页**。**③ ⭐⭐ 「bancassurance」与「takaful」出现在同一组 topics 中**——**本词条所在站点的形态普查中，「bancassurance/银保」长期为**真空白（0）**、「回教保险/takaful」则已有 [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]**；**本条目虽然不能填上银保这一形态（它不是银保业务本身，而是一份画像），但它提示了一个此前没注意到的观察面：**一家同时经营银保与回教保险的集团，其**公开 API 面**长什么样****（**本次未读画像正文，故不转述其收录了哪些 API、Kin Score 数值或 Agent Readiness 评级**）。**④ ⭐ Prudential plc **主要营运办公室在香港**这一点，使本条目对本站读者有直接关联**——**可与池内 [[hkma-open-api]]（香港金管局开放 API）、[[10life]]（香港保险比较）、[[openinsurance]] 并读：**三者分别代表监管者开放 API、消费者端比较、以及开放保险概念，而本条目是**第三方对单一保险集团 API 面的独立盘点****。**⑤ ⭐ 「Kin Score」与「Agent Readiness」两个评分名称的出现，说明该组织已把「一家公司的 API 对一个 AI 智能体是否可用」做成评分维度**（**本次未读其评分标准正文，故不转述其定义、量纲或 Rubric**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（`NONE`）**——**本词条据此明确记录，并提示引用、转载或再利用其画像内容前应自行确认授权状况**（**注意：其「下架权」声明是关于**被画像公司**的，不是关于**转载者**的授权**）；**② ⚠️ 该条目 `pushed` 为 2026-09-04，**严格在解冻窗口之外**，**本词条不将其计为本轮窗口内发现**；**③** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、20 项 topics、README 全文（10,033 字节）中的自述定位、Prudential plc 的公司描述、以及上述六条 Provenance 条款的逐字内容**，⭐ **但未读画像正文**——**未核实其实际收录了哪些 API、端点、规范文件或评分结果**，**未访问 apievangelist.com、未访问 Prudential plc 的开发者门户或任何被引用的规范**，因此**不能转述任何 API 清单、Kin Score 数值、Agent Readiness 评级、Rubric 内容或 Prudential 的实际 API 能力**；**④ ⭐ 「Kin Score 与 Agent Readiness 独立计算」为**该组织的自述**，**本次未独立验证其计算方式、可复现性或评分标准的公开程度**；**⑤ ⭐ 「无理由下架」「不因请求而给零分」「公布的服务时限」均为**自我承诺**，**本次未核实其执行记录或是否有第三方监督**；**⑥ 本词条**不主张**该画像已获 Prudential plc 认可，**也不主张其内容准确**（**按该组织自己的声明，其内容系第三方汇编**）；**⑦ 「Prudential plc 主要营运办公室在香港、在伦敦/香港/新加坡/纽约上市」为**该画像的公司描述**，**本次未对照 Prudential plc 官方材料核实**；**⑧ 该组织是否对其他保险机构也有同类画像、覆盖面多大本次未完整核实**（**抽样查询其组织仓库时另见 `first-american-financial` 与 `advise-insurance` 两条含保险关键词的画像，但**样本仅 100 个最近更新仓库、并非全量**，故不作覆盖面主张**）；**⑨** 本词条**不主张**该画像可用于任何合规、投资或安全评估用途**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/api-evangelist/prudential-plc` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 10,033 字节，六条 Provenance 条款逐字核对）；**未读画像正文、未访问 apievangelist.com 与被引用的任何规范**。
e.body_en:
**prudential-plc-api-profile** is **API Evangelist’s independent third-party profile of [[prudential|Prudential plc]]’s public API surface** (repository `api-evangelist/prudential-plc`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, no declared primary language, a 121 KB repository, created 2026-07-25 and last pushed 2026-09-04** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)**; **⚠️ its `pushed` date of 2026-09-04 falls strictly outside this round’s thaw window (`>2026-09-05`) — stated plainly; this is not a window find**. **Its 20 topics were read verbatim and directly cover regions and lines this site tracks**: **hong-kong, bancassurance, takaful, life-insurance, health-insurance, pensions, asset-management, responsible-ai, africa, asia, united-kingdom, vietnam, indonesia, malaysia, philippines, singapore, carrier, apis-json and eastspring**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 10,033-byte README**): the repository **positions itself verbatim** as **"Prudential plc — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist."**; **and states verbatim that Prudential plc is a life and health insurance and asset management group incorporated in England and Wales, listed on the London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York exchanges, with its principal operating office in Hong Kong**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The entry’s real value is not the profile’s content but the Provenance block it opens with — six clauses stating what it is and is not, read verbatim**:
**① "This is not our API."** — **the repository is an independent, third-party profile of a company’s publicly available API surface, maintained by API Evangelist, which does not operate, host, resell or support the company’s APIs and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the company unless stated on the profile.**
**② Source discipline** — **"Everything here is assembled from material a member of the public can reach with a browser and no credentials"** — the company’s own site, developer portal and documentation, the specifications it publishes for public use (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schema, `apis.json`, `llms.txt` and similar), its public repositories, and its public status, pricing and changelog pages; ⭐ **closing with a strong negative: "Nothing here is obtained by breaching a system, defeating an access control, or using credentials of any kind."**
**③ Rating-scope declaration** — **the Kin Score and Agent Readiness rating are independently calculated scores of a company’s public API artifacts against a published rubric**; ⭐ **stating verbatim that "They are not certifications, endorsements, security assessments, or audits, and they score published artifacts — not the quality, safety, or security of the software."**
**④ Corrections, re-scores and removal are free** — **no partnership, contract or purchase is required, and no justification need be given.**
**⑤ The removal promise, verbatim** — **"Want the listing taken down? Say so and we will honor it."**; **the profile is then reduced to the company name, a factual description and a link to its own site, and the company is recorded as unrated**; ⭐ **with the verbatim commitment "never scored zero for having asked"**.
**⑥ Published service-level times** — **acknowledgement within one business day; removal or restriction within two business days; corrections and re-scores within five business days.**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A model of third-party profiling self-discipline is the round’s most valuable finding, and it shares its method with the site this entry lives on** — **this site also profiles institutions as a third party, without credentials, labelling sources item by item; API Evangelist writes the boundaries into declarative clauses**: **not our API / no credentials / a rating is not a security audit / removal on request without justification / never zero for asking / published response times**. **Four of the six clauses actively limit the reach of its own conclusions**; **a directly borrowable template of "I write this, but read it this way" for students producing research reports, industry analyses or institutional profiles** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], the "what it does not prove" of round 319’s [[powmcp-skills]] and the "items to verify" of [[insurance-review]] — all four address the same thing: stopping others from reading your conclusion as stronger than it is**). **② ⭐⭐ The "no credentials of any kind" source discipline deserves separate note** — **it contrasts with this session’s measured blocks such as `register.eiopa.europa.eu` (403, round 317) and HCAA (403, round 316)**: **when an authoritative source is gated, a third-party profile must either give up or use publicly reachable material and state the material boundary**; **API Evangelist chose the latter and put it on the front page**. **③ ⭐⭐ "Bancassurance" and "takaful" appearing in the same topic set is notable** — **in this site’s form census, bancassurance has long been a true zero while takaful already has [[bnm-insurance-takaful]]**; **this entry cannot fill the bancassurance form (it is a profile, not bancassurance business), but it points to a previously unnoticed surface: what the public API face of a group operating both bancassurance and takaful looks like** (**the profile body was not read, so no API listing, Kin Score or Agent Readiness rating is restated**). **④ ⭐ That Prudential plc’s principal operating office is in Hong Kong gives this entry direct relevance for this site’s readers** — **readable with [[hkma-open-api]] (the HKMA open API), [[10life]] (Hong Kong insurance comparison) and [[openinsurance]]: a regulator’s open API, a consumer comparison and the open-insurance concept, whereas this is an independent inventory of one insurance group’s API surface**. **⑤ ⭐ The two rating names, Kin Score and Agent Readiness, show the organisation has made "how usable a company’s API is to an AI agent" a scoring dimension** (**its rubric was not read, so no definition, scale or rubric content is restated**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (`NONE`) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before quoting, republishing or reusing its profile content** (**note: its removal right concerns the profiled company, not a republisher’s licence**); **② ⚠️ the entry’s `pushed` date of 2026-09-04 is strictly outside the thaw window**, **and it is not counted as a window find**; **③** this check verified **the repository metadata, 20 topics, and the README’s 10,033 bytes in respect of its positioning statement, its description of Prudential plc, and the verbatim text of the six Provenance clauses**, ⭐ **but did not read the profile body** — **what APIs, endpoints, specification files or rating results it actually contains was not verified**, **apievangelist.com was not visited, nor Prudential plc’s developer portal nor any cited specification**, so **no API listing, Kin Score, Agent Readiness rating, rubric or actual Prudential API capability can be restated**; **④ ⭐ The claim that the Kin Score and Agent Readiness are independently calculated is the organisation’s own**, **and neither the calculation, its reproducibility, nor the public availability of the rubric was independently verified**; **⑤ ⭐ The no-justification removal right, the never-zero pledge and the published response times are self-commitments**, **and no execution record or third-party oversight was verified**; **⑥** the entry **does not claim the profile is endorsed by Prudential plc, nor that its content is accurate** (**by the organisation’s own statement it is third-party compilation**); **⑦ The statements that Prudential plc’s principal operating office is in Hong Kong and that it is listed in London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York are the profile’s own company description**, **not checked against Prudential plc’s official material**; **⑧ whether the organisation has comparable profiles for other insurers, and its coverage, were not fully verified** (**sampling its organisation repositories also surfaced `first-american-financial` and `advise-insurance`, but the sample was 100 recently updated repositories, not the full set, so no coverage claim is made**); **⑨** the entry **does not claim the profile is usable for any compliance, investment or security assessment**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/api-evangelist/prudential-plc` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 10,033-byte README with the six Provenance clauses checked verbatim); **the profile body was not read, and apievangelist.com and the cited specifications were not visited**.
e.body_hk:
**prudential-plc-api-profile** 是 **API Evangelist 對 Prudential plc 公開 API 面的獨立第三方畫像**（倉庫 `api-evangelist/prudential-plc`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言未標註、體量 121 KB、創建於 2026-07-25、最後推送 2026-09-04**；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`NONE`）**；**⚠️ 其 `pushed` 為 2026-09-04，嚴格落在本輪解凍窗口（`>2026-09-05`）之外——如實標註，並非窗口內發現**。**其 topics 逐字實測達 20 項，直接覆蓋本站關注的區域與險種**：**hong-kong、bancassurance、takaful、life-insurance、health-insurance、pensions、asset-management、responsible-ai、africa、asia、united-kingdom、vietnam、indonesia、malaysia、philippines、singapore、carrier、apis-json、eastspring**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，10,033 位元組**）：⭐ **逐字定位**：**「Prudential plc — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist.」**；**並逐字說明 Prudential plc 為在英格蘭與威爾士註冊的人壽與健康保險及資產管理集團，在倫敦、香港、新加坡與紐約交易所上市，**主要營運辦公室在香港****。⭐⭐⭐ **本條目最有價值的是開篇的 Provenance 區塊——它逐項交代自己是什麼、不是什麼**：
**① 「This is not our API.」**——**該倉庫是某公司**公開可用** API 面的獨立第三方畫像；API Evangelist 不運營、不託管、不轉售、不支持該公司的 API，且除另有說明外與該公司無關聯或背書**。
**② 來源紀律**——**「此處一切資訊均由**任何公眾成員用瀏覽器、無需任何憑證**即可取得的材料彙編而成」**（公司自身網站、開發者門戶與文檔、其公開發布的規範如 OpenAPI／AsyncAPI／JSON Schema／`apis.json`／`llms.txt`、其公開倉庫、以及公開的狀態/定價/變更日誌）；⭐ **並以一句極強的否定句收尾：「Nothing here is obtained by breaching a system, defeating an access control, or using credentials of any kind.」**
**③ 評分範圍聲明**——**Kin Score 與 Agent Readiness 是對一家公司**公開** API 產物、依已公布評分標準獨立計算的分數**；⭐ **逐字強調「They are not certifications, endorsements, security assessments, or audits, and they score published artifacts — not the quality, safety, or security of the software.」**
**④ 更正、重評與下架免費**——**「無需任何合作、合同或購買，且你不需要為請求給出理由。」**
